name: float64 Editor
description: Changes the GD editor logic to save certain values at full float64

float64-object-position.name: float64 Object Position
float64-object-position.description: Overrides the default saving logic for object positions and save at float64 instead of 1 decimal place

float64-object-rotation.name: float64 Object Rotation
float64-object-rotation.description: Overrides the default saving logic for object rotations and save at float64 instead of truncating; also applies to warp transforms

float64-object-scale.name: float64 Object Scale
float64-object-scale.description: Overrides the default saving logic for object scale and save at float64 instead of truncating; applies to both X and Y scales

float64-trigger-parameters.name: float64 Trigger Parameters
float64-trigger-parameters.description: Overrides the default saving logic for trigger parameters and save at float64 instead of truncating; applies to most triggers

write-math-expressions.name: Write Math Expressions
write-math-expressions.description: Allows entering custom math formulas like 1/3, pi, e, or sqrt(2) into the editor input boxes.
